q: Who gives the final answer for a domain's records?
why: Resolvers ask down the delegation chain to the authoritative server.

q: Why do DNS changes take time to appear?
o: Caches keep old answers until their TTL runs out
why: Lower the TTL before planned changes.

q: DNS over HTTPS (DoH) proves the records are authentic.
why: Myth. DoH hides queries from the network; DNSSEC is what signs the records.
